description: Orbit webserver dashboard. The top section answers whether the service is healthy: throughput, success rate, latency of successful queries, and errors by type. Lower rows break down latency, reliability, and resources. The per-domain catalog reference is collapsed at the bottom.

panels.description: Valid queries per minute, averaged over the selected time range: successful queries and server failures. Excludes rejected client queries and schema calls.
panels.title: Queries/min

panels.description: Share of valid queries in the selected time range that did not fail on the server side. Objective: 99.5%. Amber below the objective, red below 95%. Rejected client queries are not counted.

targets.expr: 1 - ((sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status=~"execution_error|timeout|streaming_error|content_resolution_error|authorization_error|custom_error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(gkg_query_engine_compiler_rejected_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", failure_reason=~"lowering|enforcement|codegen|pipeline|ontology_internal|security"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status!~"compile_error|security_error", query_type!="unknown"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Success

panels.description: Queries that failed because of the service in the selected time range: execution, timeout, streaming, content resolution, redaction, and compiler faults. The count grows with the time range, so it stays neutral; the Success tile judges it. See the chart below for the split by type.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status=~"execution_error|timeout|streaming_error|content_resolution_error|authorization_error|custom_error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(gkg_query_engine_compiler_rejected_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", failure_reason=~"lowering|enforcement|codegen|pipeline|ontology_internal|security"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Server errors

panels.description: Share of successful queries in the selected time range that finished in 5 seconds or less.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown", le="5.0"}[$__range])) / (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_count{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Under 5 s

panels.description: Median duration of successful queries in the selected time range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[$__range]))) >= 0

panels.title: p50

panels.description: p95 duration of successful queries in the selected time range. Amber from 5 s, red from 25 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[$__range]))) >= 0

panels.title: p95

panels.description: p99 duration of successful queries in the selected time range. Amber from 25 s, the long-tail objective (99% of queries within 25 s).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[$__range]))) >= 0

panels.title: p99

panels.description: Share of queries in the selected time range (schema calls excluded) that were rejected before running: invalid client input (bad syntax, unknown schema, and so on) or a user with no enabled namespace. Not a service fault, so it stays neutral.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status=~"compile_error|security_error"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])) - (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type="unknown"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) > 0)

panels.title: Rejected

panels.description: All queries that reached the pipeline in the selected time range, including rejected client queries and excluding schema calls. The curve shows volume per 5 minutes or more.

targets.expr: sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__interval])) - (sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type="unknown"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Queries

panels.description: Queries in the selected time range by outcome: successful, failed because of the service, and rejected as invalid client input. Totals sum 5-minute or longer buckets, so they can differ by a few from the tiles above.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(gkg_query_pipeline_queries_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status=~"execution_error|timeout|streaming_error|content_resolution_error|authorization_error|custom_error"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(gkg_query_engine_compiler_rejected_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", failure_reason=~"lowering|enforcement|codegen|pipeline|ontology_internal|security"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[30m])))

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, query_type) (rate(gkg_query_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", status="ok", query_type!="unknown"}[10m])))

panels.title: p95 of successful queries by query type

panels.description: p95 per pipeline stage stacked together. The visual height tells you which stage is eating the budget on a slow request — compile, authorization, execute, or hydration.
panels.title: Server: pipeline stages p95 (stacked)

panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of the pipeline execute stage — the time spent waiting on ClickHouse. Execute spike + flat compile/hydrate means a slow query plan, not server overhead.
panels.title: Server: ClickHouse execute (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of the hydration stage — graph response shaping after ClickHouse returns. Hydration spike + flat execute means the row count is huge; cross-check the result-set rows panel below.
panels.title: Server: hydration (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Bytes and rows pulled from ClickHouse per second. Lets you cross-correlate execute-stage latency with the volume of work the query actually did.
panels.title: ClickHouse: bytes / rows read per second

panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of ClickHouse memory_usage reported per query. A jump here often correlates with execute-stage latency and is the first signal of a query plan regression.
panels.title: ClickHouse: memory_usage_bytes per query (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: p50/p95/p99 of how many rows each query returned. A latency climb that tracks a row-count climb is just more work; a climb that does not is a regression.
panels.title: Server: result-set rows per query (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Pipeline failure counts in rolling 1h windows, broken down by failure_reason from `gkg.query.pipeline.failed`. Renders a flat zero baseline when no failures occur in the window.
panels.title: Server: pipeline failures by reason (1h windows)

panels.description: Compiler rejections grouped by failure_reason from `gkg.query.engine.compiler.rejected`: parse/schema/reference/ontology/ontology_internal/depth/limit/security/lowering/enforcement/codegen/pipeline. Renders a flat zero baseline when no rejections occur in the window.
panels.title: Server: compiler rejections by reason (1h windows)

panels.description: Current count of active gRPC requests on the Orbit webserver, summed across pods. A flat ceiling here is the saturation signal for the gRPC server.
panels.title: Server: in-flight gRPC requests

panels.description: Time to resolve content for a request via Gitaly. Spikes here usually correspond with execute-stage latency on queries that touch blob content.
panels.title: Resolve duration (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Number of items per content-resolve batch. Useful for telling apart "many small calls" from "one fat call" when interpreting the duration panel.
panels.title: Resolve batch size (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Total list_blobs RPCs issued to Gitaly.
panels.title: gkg_content_gitaly_calls_total — rate/s

panels.description: Webserver serving schema state (pending|ready); 1 indicates the active state per `state` label.
panels.title: gkg_webserver_schema_state

panels.description: Aggregate CPU seconds used per second divided by configured CPU limit, across all webserver replicas. 1.0 means the pool is fully consuming its quota.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", cpu="total"}[5m]))) / (sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="gkg", resource="cpu"}) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU: usage / limit (5m)

panels.description: Working-set memory across all replicas as a fraction of the aggregate memory limit. Watch for sustained values above ~0.85 — that is OOM-kill territory.

targets.expr: ((sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster"})) / (sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container=~"(gkg|orbit)-webserver", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="gkg", resource="memory"}) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Memory: working set / limit

panels.description: Total OOM-killer events across webserver replicas in the selected time range. Any non-zero value warrants a look at the memory panel below.
panels.title: OOM events (1h)

panels.description: Container restarts across webserver replicas in the selected time range. Crash-loops show up here before they show up in the app metrics.
panels.title: Restarts (1h)

panels.description: Per-pod CPU seconds consumed per second. The dashed reference line is the per-pod CPU limit from kube-state-metrics; pods bumping against it should be cross-checked with the throttling panel.
panels.title: CPU: cores used per pod

panels.description: Share of CFS periods where the cgroup was throttled. Anything sustained above ~5% means the pod is hitting its CPU quota and requests will queue.
panels.title: CPU: throttled time fraction per pod

panels.description: container_memory_working_set_bytes per replica. The dashed reference line is the per-pod memory limit. Working set is what the OOM killer reads, not RSS.
panels.title: Memory: working set per pod

panels.description: Resident set and page cache, per pod. RSS dominating with a tiny cache often means heap growth; cache dominating typically means heavy I/O.
panels.title: Memory: RSS and cache per pod

panels.description: Read and write throughput from cAdvisor. Sustained climbs here on the webserver usually point at log volume or temp-file churn.
panels.title: Filesystem I/O bytes per pod

panels.description: PSI seconds per second. IO pressure rising means processes are waiting on disk; memory pressure rising means the kernel is reclaiming pages, often the leading edge of an OOM.
panels.title: Pressure stall: IO and memory

panels.description: OS-level concurrency counters. Threads climbing without a corresponding workload increase usually points at a tokio blocking-pool growth event; sockets climbing flags a connection leak.
panels.title: Threads and sockets per pod
